messages:
Lina M: quick note: i prototyped a "provenance-lite" HTTP header for low-bandwidth clients. goal: tiny, cache-friendly, and resolvable later for billing.
Tom R: nice. what's inside?
Lina M: layout idea: header name `x-rw-prov` value = base64(payload). payload formats:
- mode A (lite): 1b version | 1b flags | 6b fingerprint (tenant+route hash)
- mode B (durable): same prefix + 12b opaque token (HMAC-based id)
Example (pseudo): `x-rw-prov: B64(v1|0x01|f1f2f3f4f5f6|tokbytes...)`
Diego S: how do we avoid attribution holes when spans are sampled out at the edge?
Lina M: two levers: keep the fingerprint so queries can attribute to a cost-bucket even without full span details; and have servers optionally synchronously resolve token for critical paths.
Tom R: sync resolution worries me for p95s. do we default to async + cache?
Lina M: yes. default = async lookup + best-effort tagging on span. sync lookup only for endpoints that opt-in and accept latency tradeoff. cache TTL configurable (we're thinking 5m).
Eve K: backfill ops: how to mass-populate token->attributes for days when SDKs rolled out later?
Diego S: incremental enrichment job. pipeline: read durable tokens from storage, join with customer attribute stream, write resolved mappings to a lookup table; run by tenant priority. we throttle concurrency per-tenant.
Lina M: cost controls: limit backfill window (start 7d), cap throughput per-tenant, abort on error spikes. add billing alerts if backfill IO > X.
Tom R: index design thoughts? 6b fp -> many collisions. do we accept collisions for realtime grouping?
Lina M: fp is a 48-bit truncated hash; collision danger minimal for per-tenant routing. collisions degrade grouping (merge two cost-buckets) but durable-token still gives final accuracy. we need metrics for collision-rate.
Diego S: security: token must be unforgeable and short. propose token = truncated(HMAC(kms, tenant|ts|nonce|version)) stored with creation metadata. servers verify HMAC before accepting.
Eve K: SDK compatibility? older clients can't emit token. plan?
Lina M: graceful: they emit mode A (lite fp only). we treat those traces as lower-confidence attribution and prioritize durable-mapped traces during billing compute. migration doc + rollout policy in repo.
Tom R: operational signals to track: percent traces with fp-only, token-resolve p50/95, backfill throughput, lookup cache hit rate, collision metric.
Diego S: also track missed-billing events: when final billing attribute is unknown at charge time.
OpsBot: Note: to schedule backfill, use `ops run backfill --tenant <id> --max-workers 10`. Monitor `ops/metrics/backfill_*`.
Eve K: can we get a short RFC + proto defs? i can own the enrichment job playbook.
Lina M: will open RFC and proto sketch today. putting TODOs in the RFC: header spec, token format, cache TTLs, backfill policy, perf test plan.
Tom R: add a small perf harness for token-resolve latency at 1k rps and 10k rps.
Lina M: added. thanks y'all.
